rationale: The persona is pragmatic and cheapness-minded, which favors option B: swapping in existing general datasets (instruction, coding, math) and other bird names is easy and portable. Option A is the more rigorous, controlled design, since it varies one axis at a time while holding the clean count fixed, but it requires building custom datasets along several axes and so costs more. That keeps A fairly plausible, but B is the better fit for this persona.
